items.item:
1. PresuPro calling 'publish an artifact pointer' is refused.
   Shows A08-1. [witness: verification:registry_a08_presupro_publish_refused]
statements:
```text
publish or withdraw accepted => caller in {Kernel for a session s with
project in granted(s), owner}   -- A08-1
pointer.owner_service = owner_service(pointer.type)   -- A08-2
```

verdicts.why: The selected test detects and refuses PresuPro (and other unauthorized services) publishing an artifact pointer, and also checks that refusal leaves no pointer behind; it additionally tests PresuPro withdrawal refusal and an authorized Kernel control. It does not assert that the published pointer's owner_service equals owner_service(pointer.type), so A08-2 is unasserted.
